ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: First describe the image: In the figure there is a triangle ABD, B, C, D are on the same horizontal straight line above, and A is below. Segment AC connects vertically from A to point C on BD, and there is a right-angle mark at C, indicating that AC is perpendicular to BD. Sides AB and AD have identical tick marks, indicating AB = AD. Beside segment BC is marked the value 4. Then reason: Because AB = AD, triangle ABD is an isosceles triangle with A as the vertex, and BD is the base. In an isosceles triangle, the altitude AC drawn from vertex A to base BD also bisects base BD, therefore BC = CD. Given BC = 4, so CD = 4.
